title: The Public Finance Management Act, 2018
summary: Sample extraction of public finance management controls covering treasury responsibilities, controlling officers, audit committees, the Consolidated Fund, banking, and disposal of public assets.
memorandumPoints: Treasury and public finance management structure
Responsibilities of controlling and accounting officers
Control of public finances and the Consolidated Fund
Management of public assets and stores
Control of state-owned enterprises and statutory corporations
arrangementHighlights: Control of public funds and bank accounts
Management and disposal of public assets and stores

sampleClauses.heading: Controlling officers
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A payment, grant, or commitment is submitted
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Require accountable-officer review before the council commits public resources.

sampleClauses.heading: Fiduciary duties of controlling officer and controlling body
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A high-value approval or exception override is requested
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Prevent irregular expenditure and preserve auditable evidence for approvals.

sampleClauses.heading: Audit committees
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: Quarter-end review or unresolved audit finding
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Escalate open audit observations through the audit committee workflow.

sampleClauses.heading: Disbursement from Consolidated Fund
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: Funds are released from the consolidated fund or a warrant is prepared
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Require treasury-backed release approval and traceable allocation to the proper vote.

sampleClauses.heading: Bank accounts in respect of public monies
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A public-money account is opened, changed, or reconciled
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Ensure all public monies are held and reconciled through approved bank accounts.
